root_cause_candidates.evidence: Only 5 tools registered: health_check, git_status, list_directory, read_file, write_file. No 'diagnostic' entry matching 'diagnostica con herramientas' or 'muestra cuales fueron los ultimos cambios'

root_cause_candidates.description: AgentLoop has no LLM pool preflight — enters 12-step loop even when all models are circuit-broken
root_cause_candidates.evidence: loop.py:190 for step_id in range(effective_steps) — no check for model availability before starting. When Ollama is down all steps produce LLM errors and loop exhausts without result.

root_cause_candidates.description: 'diagnostica' is in _COMPLEX_SIGNALS -> complexity=complex -> 12 steps (not a regression, just amplifies RC-B)
root_cause_candidates.evidence: loop.py:404 _COMPLEX_SIGNALS includes 'diagnostica'. This assigns 12 steps. Identical in db21ae89 and HEAD.

most_likely_root_cause: RC-B is the primary root cause: AgentLoop has no LLM pool availability check before entering the step loop. When all models (kimi_cloud, codex, deepseek14b, llama8b) are unavailable (Ollama down + no API keys), every step fails silently and the loop runs 12 iterations of timeout/error before returning max_steps_reached. RC-A is a contributing design gap: the formal TOOL01 deterministic router should handle 'diagnostic' requests, but currently doesn't have an entry for them.
not_a_regression_reason: All commits from db21ae89 through 810a052d have identical _should_use_agent, _TOOL01_ROUTER_PATTERNS, _classify_complexity, and AgentLoop behavior. The gap was always latent. It only manifests now because the full LLM pool (Ollama) is unavailable.
previous_good_commit_or_artifact: None — there is no previous commit where this worked correctly when Ollama was down. The system always required at least one LLM model to function for agent-routed requests.
regression_summary: Not a regression. A latent design gap: no LLM preflight before AgentLoop + no formal TOOL01 entry for diagnostic requests. Exposed when Ollama service is offline.

recommended_patch_design.approach: TWO minimal targeted changes: (1) In session.py _TOOL01_ROUTER_PATTERNS: add 'diagnostic_general' tool entry with patterns like r'\bdiagnostica\b.*\bherramienta', r'herramientas reales', r'ultimos cambios.*ui'. Map it to sequential execution of health_check + git_status using existing _tool01_execute path. (2) In agent/loop.py: add LLM preflight at top of run() — call a lightweight availability check (e.g. query LLMManager for circuit status) before entering the step loop. If all models are circuit-open, return early with status='llm_pool_unavailable' instead of running 12 steps.

change_2_loop_py.action: Check LLMManager circuit breaker status. If all models in chosen chain are circuit-open (failed recently), return immediately with status='llm_pool_unavailable', success=False, useful message.
